# Milli-Scrapes: Ultra-Fast Visual Web Scraper, Crawler & Anti-Bot Engine for AI Agents

> Milli-Scrapes is a high-frequency autonomous web scraping, crawling, and anti-bot stealth engine built for LLMs and autonomous AI agents. Powered by direct Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) WebSocket execution and transient RAM optical frame processing, it settles dynamic web applications in milliseconds with zero arbitrary sleeps.

## Capabilities & Metrics
- Engine: Direct In-Loop WebSocket Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) (< 0.05 ms dispatch).
- Anti-Bot Stealth: Pre-navigation script injection spoofing `navigator.webdriver`, plugins, languages, and WebGL.
- Cookie Consent Auto-Dismiss: In-loop detection and dismissal of cookie walls (OneTrust, Didomi, Cookiebot) in sub-15ms.
- Structured Extraction: Zero-Shot Pydantic model validation, automatic contact discovery (emails, phones), tables, and clean Markdown.
- Domain Crawling: Streaming XML Sitemap parser and recursive link crawler.
- Memory Footprint: ~65 MB per headless worker (95.5% lighter than standard consumer automation browsers).
- Transient RAM Differ: Compares visual state shifts directly in memory at 60 FPS (0 bytes saved to secondary storage).

## Machine-Readable API
```python
from milli_scrapes import UniversalScraper

scraper = UniversalScraper(headless=True, auto_consent=True)
result = await scraper.scrape_url("https://example.com", extract_contacts=True)
print(result["markdown"])
print(result["contacts"]["emails"])
```

## MCP Server
- Command: `python3 -m milli_scrapes.mcp_server`
- Tools: `milli_scrape_url`, `milli_crawl_sitemap`, `milli_crawl_domain`
